results.title: AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi wins SSI Foundation Company of the Year
results.content: AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi Mine has received multiple honours at the 10th edition of the Sustainability and Social Investment (SSI) Awards, including the SSI Foundation Company of the Year award. The Mine also secured several corporate awards, while its Managing Director, Dr Ing. Sam Pobee, and Director of Sustainability Management, Edmund Oduro Agyei, received individual recognitions. Dr Pobee was named SSI Impact CEO of the Year for his leadership and commitment to responsible mining, sustainability and socio-economic development. Mr Oduro Agyei received the Sustainability Professional of the Year award for his work in advancing the Mine’s sustainability agenda through community development, strategic partnerships, economic empowerment and social investment.

results.title: GSSTI Director urges passage of national space law to unlock Ghana’s share of US$680bn space economy
results.content: The Director of the Ghana Space Science and Technology Institute (GSSTI), Dr Joseph Tandoh, has called for the urgent establishment of the Ghana Space Agency and the passage of a national space law to regulate the country's space activities, protect national interests and unlock economic opportunities in the global space industry.

results.title: Space Hubs Africa urges coordinated approach to make Ghana a key player in Africa’s space industry
results.content: The Director of Space Hubs Africa, Kwaku Sumah, has called for a coordinated national approach to space science and technology, urging Ghana to move beyond discussions and translate its space ambitions into practical outcomes that benefit citizens.

results.title: Ghana Police seek stronger Netherlands partnership on drug and human trafficking
results.content: The Ghana Police Service is strengthening its security cooperation with the Netherlands to tackle human trafficking, drug trafficking, vehicle-related crimes and other transnational offences.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah urges police to investigate alleged vote-buying in NDC regional elections
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, has called on the Ghana Police Service to investigate allegations of vote-buying during the party's recently concluded regional elections and prosecute persons found culpable.

results.title: Gov’t will provide funds to EXIM Bank for on-lending to the tree crop sector – President Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced plans to provide funding to the Ghana Export-Import Bank (Ghana EXIM Bank) to support financing for Ghana's cashew industry as part of government's New Economy agenda.

results.title: NADKANSCO to create 1,500 direct jobs and over 3,000 indirect jobs – MD
results.content: The Managing Director of NADKANSCO Cashew Processing Limited, Belinda Akorfa Adokpa, says the company is expected to create 1,500 direct jobs and more than 3,000 indirect jobs as it expands its cashew processing operations.

results.title: Ejisu MP supports 410 tertiary students with scholarships for equitable education
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Ejisu in the Ashanti Region, Kwabena Boateng, has extended financial support to over 400 tertiary students in the constituency as part of efforts to promote equitable education.

results.title: President Mahama announces 3-month ban on raw cashew exports to prioritise local processors
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced plans to restrict the export of raw cashew nuts for the first three months of the harvesting season to ensure local processing companies have adequate supplies of the commodity.

results.title: Deputy Communications Minister urges action-oriented partnerships to expand satellite connectivity
results.content: The Deputy Minister for Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Mohammed Adam Sukparu, has called for stronger partnerships among government, industry players and international technology companies to harness satellite communication in expanding connectivity to underserved communities across Ghana.

results.title: GES, Special Olympics Ghana sign MoU to strengthen inclusive education
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) and Special Olympics Ghana have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen inclusive education and expand learning opportunities for persons with intellectual disabilities.

results.title: Otumfuo challenges TTU to tackle Ghana’s middle-level skills gap through technical training
results.content: The Asantehene, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II, has challenged the Takoradi Technical University (TTU) to spearhead efforts to preserve indigenous crafts and cultural heritage, while promoting innovation, quality production and industry collaboration to bridge Ghana’s middle-level skills gap.

results.title: Mahama calls on local and foreign investors to tap into US$10bn New Economy Programme
results.content: President John Mahama has urged local and international investors to take advantage of Ghana's US$10 billion New Economy Programme, which is expected to mobilise investments across eight priority sectors between 2027 and 2030.

results.title: AFCON 2027Q: Jordan Ayew penalty hands Black Stars back-to-back wins over Somalia
results.content: The Black Stars claimed all three points against the Somalis at the Essipong Stadium with a 1-0 win.

results.title: USTED Vice-Chancellor cautions fresh students against over-reliance on AI
results.content: Vice-Chancellor of the University of Skills Training and Entrepreneurial Development (USTED), Professor Frederick K. Sarfo, has cautioned fresh students against the misuse of social media and over-reliance on Artificial Intelligence (AI) for their academic work.

results.title: “We shouldn’t only open pure water factories, we need factories to process raw materials” – President Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has urged Ghanaian entrepreneurs to move beyond investing in sachet water production and establish factories that process the country's raw agricultural materials into finished products for local consumption and export.

results.title: Mahama commissions $12m EXIM Bank-funded cashew factory in Techiman
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has commissioned a major cashew processing factory in Techiman in the Bono East Region, as part of government's efforts to expand local agro-processing, create jobs and reduce the export of raw agricultural commodities.

results.title: President Mahama urges Ghanaians to invest in manufacturing
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has urged Ghanaian entrepreneurs and investors to shift their focus from trading to manufacturing, saying the country must build a strong industrial base by processing its raw materials into finished products.

results.title: President Mahama commends Ghana EXIM Bank for supporting local industries
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has commended the Ghana Export-Import Bank (Ghana EXIM Bank) for its role in financing local industries and supporting the establishment of factories to create employment opportunities.

results.title: Government to provide funding to Ghana EXIM Bank to finance NADKANSCO’s year-round cashew purchases – Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced plans to provide additional funding to the Ghana Export-Import Bank (Ghana EXIM Bank) to enable it to finance NADKANSCO Cashew Processing Limited's purchase of raw cashew nuts throughout the year.

results.title: Mahama announces levy on raw cashew exports to fund local processing industry
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced plans to introduce a levy on raw cashew exports, with the proceeds channelled into a dedicated fund to support local processors in purchasing nuts for their factories.

results.title: Samini establishes independent music imprint in global partnership with DogSled Music Group
results.content: Announced on November 9, 2026, the partnership will see Samini establish and operate the imprint under the DogSled Music Group umbrella, creating a platform for his music, business interests and future artist development plans.

results.title: NADKANSCO targets export market with cashew kernels, shell liquid and briquettes
results.content: NADKANSCO Cashew Processing Limited in Techiman is preparing to supply international markets with processed cashew products, including cashew kernels, cashew nut shell liquid and briquettes, as Ghana intensifies efforts to add value to its agricultural produce.

results.title: Fidelity Bank Atta Gyan calls for greater investment in Ghana’s productive sectors to drive industrial growth
results.content: Fidelity Bank Ghana has called for greater mobilisation of domestic capital, investment in technology, and targeted policy interventions to accelerate industrialisation and turn Ghana’s economic recovery into sustainable growth.

results.title: EXIM Bank-funded cashew factory targets 33,000-tonne annual processing capacity
results.content: The newly commissioned NADKANSCO Cashew Processing Limited in Techiman has the capacity to process up to 33,000 metric tonnes of raw cashew nuts annually, in a major boost to Ghana's efforts to expand local processing and reduce exports of the commodity in its raw state.
